entries.source: StAN, Fürstentum Ansbach, Geheimes Archiv: Oberamt Uffenheim, Urkunden 145
entries.german: Spruchbrief: Bischof Lorenz von Würzburg entscheidet in Streitsachen zwischen Philipp Herrn zu Weinsberg d.Ä. eines Teils, dann Asmus von Rosenberg, Ritter, und Lienhard seinem Sohn anderen Teils des Jagens halber, wegen des Flachslegens in die Gollach, ferner des Schaftriebs halber in die Mark zu Gulchsheim etc.
entries.english: Arbitration award: Bishop Lorenz of Würzburg decides in disputes between Philipp the Elder, Lord of Weinsberg, on one side, and Asmus von Rosenberg, knight, and his son Lienhard on the other side, concerning hunting, regarding laying flax in the Gollach, furthermore concerning driving sheep into the market at Gülchsheim, etc.

facts.content: was party with his son Leonhard to a dispute with Philipp der Ältere, Herr zu Weinsberg, concerning hunting, flax in the Gollach and sheep grazing near Gülchsheim.
